items.title: Mac DeMarco’s Four Secret Tour-Only CDs Are Now On Streaming
items.summary: Last fall, Mac DeMarco handed out CD-R copies of an unannounced new album called Dog On The Rock on his European tour. That wasn't the only secret, tour-only DeMarco album to materialize over the past year. He's since created three more CDs, distributed under the titles Seven Off The Two , Seaplane Dog , and The View From Tian Tian . These were previously little treasures available only to those who went to see a Mac DeMarco show, but as of today, the whole world gets to partake. The post Mac DeMarco’s Four Secret Tour-Only CDs Are Now On Streaming appeared first on Stereogum .

items.title: Erykah Badu & The Alchemist Release New Album Before The World Blows Feat. Steve Lacy, Earl Sweatshirt, Thundercat, & More
items.summary: It's here! It exists! Way back in March 2025, Erykah Badu revealed that she was working on a collaborative album with rap production giant the Alchemist. This was obviously a big deal, since Badu hadn't released an album since 2010's New Amerykah Part Two (Return Of The Ankh) or an album-length work since the 2015 mixtape But You Caint Use My Phone . Badu and Alchemist released a single called " Next To You " last June, and then nothing. Finally, after more than a year, they returned with the single " Witch Doctor " earlier this month, and they announced that the LP finally had a release date.

items.title: Protomartyr – “Feed The Sewer”

items.title: ConjureDSP releases ConjureAlign, a FREE tool for fixing phase issues
items.summary: ConjureDSP has released ConjureAlign, a free and open-source plugin that automatically time-aligns two microphones recording the same source. When you record something with multiple microphones, sound reaches each microphone at a slightly different time. Combining those recordings can introduce phase cancellation and comb filtering, both of which are super common in multi-mic setups. In the early 2000s, the band's blend of Southern rock, psychedelia, dub, classic songcraft, loner country, and experimental folk put them on the forefront of festival stages. And now, James has a new solo album: Wowed Out . It’s his first solo music in eight years, and a killer return to form. Touching on soul, psychedelic pop, folk, and ambient sounds, it’s some of the most spiritual music James has ever recorded, and tellingly, this conversation takes a heady, mystical turn.
